title: Transportation Optimization: Decision charter
summary: Minimize total supplier-to-customer cash distribution cost while satisfying all customer demand and respecting supplier supply and transportation-capacity limits.. Decision charter evidence captured from the governed transportation workflow.

payload.decisionTitle: Minimize total supplier-to-customer cash distribution cost while satisfying all customer demand and respecting supplier supply and transportation-capacity limits.
payload.businessObjective: Determine the least-cost allocation of cash or logistics capacity from available supplier locations to customer demand locations. Satisfy all demand, avoid exceeding supplier limits, respect transportation capacity, and produce a reproducible allocation plan for operational review.
payload.population: Five supplier locations and six customer demand locations. Each customer has a required demand quantity. Each supplier has maximum supply, transportation capacity, inventory or handling cost, and route-specific transportation cost.
payload.governanceBoundary: Operational feasibility, cost minimization, capacity limits, fulfillment requirements, reproducibility controls, exception management, and documented solver evidence.
